body:
So, my understanding is that we do `data-` prefix removal for bindings but not static attributes:
https://ng-run.com/edit/YDUN5MMIXgyL9RwIiwNd
* `data-type="button"` => `data-type="button"`
* `data-[attr.type]="'button'"` => `type="button"`
* `data-type="{{'button'}}"` => `type="button"`
* `data-[type]="'button'"` => `type="button"`

label.name: core: property / attr bindings and interpolations

body: I think that we should rationalise the current behaviour as it is too confusing right now. Having said this it might require a breaking change so should be done only around major releases.

issue.title: "data-id" gets converted to "id" when used with {{ }}
issue.body:
### Description When adding a `data-id` to an element, which just uses static text, it gets output as `data-id` attribute. However when adding a dynamic variable to the data-id attribute (e.g.: `data-id="test-{{name}}"`) and id property gets rendered to the html element. ![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2032760/112471832-ad651780-8d6c-11eb-92b2-a673423d8fb2.png) ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction ```
This div has a data-id

This div has an id but should have a data-id too.
``` https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-ivy-kib5sx?file=src%2Fapp%2Fapp.component.html ## 🔥 Exception or Error data-id with a dynamic attribute gets rendered as data-id too **Anything else relevant?** A workaround is to use `[attr.data-id]="'test-'+name"`. ![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2032760/112472110-092fa080-8d6d-11eb-9f0b-3f3ee6beac67.png) This however makes the code longer and harder to read. Note 2: these `data-id`s are used by our TA team and therefore we have a lot of them. AFAIK using these attr syntax is generates a bigger code and to be consitent with one syntax we use `[attr.data-id]` if when it is not needed.
